ABA League Player Box

Source: R/aba.R
aba_box_players.Rd

Player box score of one finished game (2001-02 on): minutes, points, shooting splits, rebounds, assists, fouls, plus/minus and valuation.

Endpoint: GET https://www.aba-liga.com/match/{game_no}/{sez}/{lea}/Overview sez = season - 2001; league = "aba2" reads https://druga.aba-liga.com with lea = 2.

Usage

aba_box_players(game_no, season, league = "aba")

Arguments

game_no

Required. Game number within the season AND league (it restarts at 1 for every season and league), e.g. 6; game_no in aba_calendar. Playoff games that were not needed leave gaps.

season

Required. Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). the wrapper sends the site's START-year key sez = season - 2001 (25). The ABA League's first season is 2001-02 (season=2002).

league

League: aba (ABA League, www.aba-liga.com, site code lea=1) or aba2 (ABA League 2, druga.aba-liga.com, lea=2). Both sites serve one database; the runtime asks the league's own host. Default "aba".

Value

A hoopR_data tibble. One row per player listed, in page order. played is false on a did-not-play row (minutes 00:00, every stat null). starter and on_court_at_end exist from 2017-18 and are null for the whole game before. The advanced pts_paint / pts_second_chance / pts_fast_break trio is null where the season has none (2008-09). plus_minus is 0 on every row of the 2008-09 sample (not tracked then). Percentages are 0-100. Join on player_id (global), not on the printed name. Every column below is always present (a zero-row tibble keeps them and their types); an answer with nothing in it raises hoopR_no_data, as in sdv-py.

col_nametypedescription
game_nointegerGame number, per season AND league: it restarts at 1 for every season and league, so a game's key is (game_no, season, league_id). Unplayed playoff games leave gaps. The {gameNo} of the match route.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26): the site's START-year key sez (25) plus 2001.
league_idintegerLeague code, the site's lea: 1 = ABA League, 2 = ABA League 2.
leaguecharacterLeague label: aba (ABA League, lea 1) or aba2 (ABA League 2, lea 2), the wrapper's league argument.
sidecharacter'home' or 'away' (the home team is listed first everywhere on the site).
team_idintegerABA club id (global: the same id in every season and in both leagues, e.g. Partizan = 22 in 2008-09 and 2025-26). Joins every frame that carries it; the calendar has club names only.
jerseyintegerJersey number worn in the game (the box lists players by jersey number).
player_idintegerABA player id (global: one person keeps one id across seasons and both leagues, e.g. Carlik Jones = 4807), cast to an integer. Join on it, never on the printed name.
player_namecharacterName as the box prints it: 'Surname I.' (diacritics kept).
starterlogicalIn the starting five: the box marks it with '' (matches the play-by-play 'in starting lineup' rows on every sample). Null for the whole game when no row carries a '' (box-only seasons, 2008-09 sample).
on_court_at_endlogicalOn court at the final buzzer: the box prints the name in bold (matches the substitutions in the play-by-play on every sample). Null for the whole game when no name is bold (box-only seasons).
playedlogicalFalse on a did-not-play row (minutes '00:00' and one empty cell across the stat columns); its stat columns are null.
minutescharacterMinutes played, 'mm:ss' text. '00:00' on did-not-play rows.
pointsintegerPoints scored (overall Pts). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fg_pctdoubleField-goal percentage over 2- and 3-point attempts, 0-100 with one decimal (FG2 + FG3 made / attempted); 0 when no attempt. Header 'overall %'. Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fg2_madeinteger2-point field goals made (FG2 M). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fg2_attinteger2-point field goals attempted (FG2 A). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fg2_pctdouble2-point percentage, 0-100 with one decimal; 0 when no attempt. Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fg3_madeinteger3-point field goals made (FG3 M). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fg3_attinteger3-point field goals attempted (FG3 A). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fg3_pctdouble3-point percentage, 0-100 with one decimal; 0 when no attempt. Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
ft_madeintegerFree throws made (FT M). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
ft_attintegerFree throws attempted (FT A). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
ft_pctdoubleFree-throw percentage, 0-100 with one decimal; 0 when no attempt. Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
reb_defintegerDefensive rebounds (Rebs D). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
reb_offintegerOffensive rebounds (Rebs O). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
reb_totintegerTotal rebounds (Rebs T). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
assistsintegerAssists made (the Ass column).
stealsintegerSteals made (the St column).
turnoversintegerTurnovers (To). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
blocksintegerShots blocked by this player or team (Blck Fv, 'in favour'). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
blocks_againstintegerOwn shots blocked by an opponent (Blck Ag, 'against'). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
foulsintegerFouls committed (Foul Cm). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
fouls_drawnintegerFouls drawn / received (Foul Rv). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
pts_paintintegerPoints in the paint (Points from Paint). Null where the season has no such column (2008-09) and on did-not-play rows.
pts_second_chanceintegerSecond-chance points (Points from 2ndCh). Null where the season has no such column (2008-09) and on did-not-play rows.
pts_fast_breakintegerFast-break points (Points from FstBr). Null where the season has no such column (2008-09) and on did-not-play rows.
plus_minusintegerPlus/minus while on court (+/-). 0 on every row of the 2008-09 sample (not tracked then). Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).
valuationintegerValuation (Val, 'rank Value'): the efficiency rating (PIR-style index) the site ranks players by. Null on did-not-play rows (played = false).

Details

Unofficial use of a public source: these wrappers read the leagues' own PHP sites (www.aba-liga.com, druga.aba-liga.com), keyless, with no bot wall; payloads are not redistributed as release assets. www.aba-liga.com/robots.txt is the single line User-agent: * (nothing disallowed, no Crawl-delay) and druga has no robots.txt; no terms page was found. The runtime waits at least 1 s per host before every request.

Coverage: box scores from 2001-02; play-by-play, the starter and on-court markers, the shot chart and the minute-by-minute score from 2017-18 (earlier games answer an empty pbp and hoopR_no_data for the helpers). A game is keyed by (game_no, season, league_id): game_no restarts at 1 for every season and league. Team and player ids are global; the calendar carries club names only. Club names are the club's CURRENT name on every season: join on team_id.

Only finished games are served: an unplayed game, or one whose period scores, team totals or play-by-play do not add up to the final score, raises hoopR_asset_fetch, as does a page for another game, season or league than asked. The three live-match helpers echo nothing about the game, so the runtime fetches the same game's match page first (one extra request) and checks the helper against it.

Times: CET means Central European wall-clock time including summer time (the label never changes); ABA League 2 prints Local time. Officials appear by name only; the player bio (birth date and place, nationality) is the public player profile.

Errors: hoopR_no_data when the site has nothing for the request (HTTP 404, an unknown game redirected to /match-not-defined/, a season the site does not hold or before 2001-02, a live-match helper with no data before 2017-18); hoopR_bad_request for an invalid argument (a non-integer id or season, a league other than aba / aba2) or HTTP 400 / 422; hoopR_asset_fetch when the fetch failed (any other non-200, a connection failure after three attempts, a redirect off the ABA sites) or the answer is not the one asked for (a page for another game, season or league, an unfinished game, a helper that does not belong to the game, layout drift). All inherit hoopR_error.

See also

Other ABA: aba_box_teams(), aba_calendar(), aba_game(), aba_pbp(), aba_periods(), aba_player(), aba_player_games(), aba_score_difference(), aba_score_flow(), aba_shots(), aba_standings()
